title: Country Case — Yemen Digital Finance Infrastructure Context

text.content: Yemen; fragmented payment and currency environment.

rich_text.plain_text: Yemen; fragmented payment and currency environment.

text.content: The World Bank's Yemen Financial Market Infrastructure and Inclusion work focuses on developing interoperable digital payment infrastructure, including a Fast Payment System and RTGS under the Central Bank in Aden. The World Bank also documents a key challenge created by different exchange rates across areas of Yemen and prior pilots of digital payments/e-wallets.
